To create a codelist for **Psoriasis**, we must include all specific clinical codes that indicate a patient currently has a diagnosis of psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis (which directly indicates psoriatic disease), as well as clinical assessments that would only be performed on someone who actively has the condition. 

We exclude codes that indicate merely a "history of" or "family history" of psoriasis, as well as distinct but similarly named conditions (such as parapsoriasis or pityriasis).
